map.需要转义成 \\|，否则会被当作列分隔符破坏整行结构，这是 Markdown 表:
Escape it as \|, otherwise it is read as a column separator and breaks the whole row — the most common pitfall with Markdown tables. Also note that line breaks inside a cell cannot be expressed directly in standard Markdown; people usually switch to the
tag (though some platforms escape HTML) or split the content into multiple records.
map.开头的非数值内容（防公式注入），可选 Excel 兼容 BOM；负数与普通文本: prefixed non-numeric content (formula-injection protection); Excel-compatible BOM optional; negative numbers and plain text are kept as-is.
map.行数取输入值并保证在 1 到 50 之间（非法时取 1），列数取输入值并保证在: Rows are clamped to 1–50 (1 when invalid) and columns to 1–20 (1 when invalid). Header and body seed are split with CSV rules: comma-separated, cells containing commas may be wrapped in double quotes ("" for a literal quote); unquoted fields are trimmed, while leading/trailing spaces inside quotes are kept and shown as   in Markdown. An unclosed double quote raises an error and stops generation. Missing cells use "C" plus the column index as a placeholder, then Markdown escaping doubles backslashes, escapes pipes and turns newlines into spaces. The separator row follows the chosen alignment, and each body row appends its row number. CSV export neutralizes non-numeric cells starting with = + - @ by prefixing an apostrophe by default and can add a UTF-8 BOM.
